steps.text: Hui-chieh:
Back when I first became Infected, my mind wasn't clear on anything.
I knew Kashchey wanted to use me to do so much, but I was always afraid. What was it he wanted me to do?
Had he planned some kind of trick, one to destroy in a blink of an eye the network of Infected I'd spent so much time setting up?
Or had he planned to let me divide the Infected? Let them drift into two camps, the urbanites and the settlers?
Or the even more frightening scenario—perhaps he'd planned for the Infected to become a new army, and for Ursus to be plunged into war once more?
I could only speculate. He hung over my head like a murky specter, impossible to chase off.
But I could only move onward.
One of the Yetis, apparently called Petrova, used cystymilk yesterday to stir-fry oilseeds. A strange recipe, for sure. The taste was pretty interesting.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Oh, that... I remember that. The time's gone so fast. It's been two whole years.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Are the stories the fighters passed around true, then? You really fought with her? From the sound of it, you both blew the entire city ruins into oblivion.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It wasn't that dramatic. Rumors always get more outlandish as time goes on... all I did was melt her Originium ice crystals.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Sashenka, no running around! You'll slip!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Look at them, just free to live. It's so nice.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: It's a duty of mine.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I never imagined you'd volunteer to teach the children.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I get along a lot better with the children than I do with Ursus. What was that about melting, just now?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: FrostNova's Originium ice crystals. A sort of Arts device her squad used, by my guess.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: That's something... I'm sure FrostNova didn't like it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: *chuckle*. Nope. I took a single breath, and she froze half my body.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And when I finally snapped out of it, she was already charging me, going for the neck with an ice blade.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I blocked it, took in the hissing sound, and this sword tasted frost for the first time in all its years.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It was probably a first for her, too, meeting someone who could chip her blade...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Ah, you're pretty happy to talk about this. Are you proud of it, maybe?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Not really... yeah maybe you are right... uh. That child. The one hiding behind the wood fence. What's her name?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Lyubov. That's enough spying on us, Liuba! I'll read a story for you all next period.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: That's right, a story all about an old ghost in the gray forest... a scary story!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Could you help bring me some wood shavings? Put them in a basket. Thank you.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: So then?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: FrostNova... Alina, you know it's FrostNova we're talking about. Her name spread among the Casters of the Northwestern Tundra long before mine ever did.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I thought you didn't like it when people spoke your name.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If anyone ever uses it to threaten, then of course I won't be happy. But if hearing my name makes them want to challenge me, then that's not too shabby.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Nothing like you. I don't think FrostNova ever gives challenges the time of day. Thinking about it that way, you really stoked her fire, didn't you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: She's the top of the Infected Casters, the top squad commander, and the strongest of the Infected's warriors to boot.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Don't misunderstand. It's not like that's what I aim for.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Plenty of people think you resemble each other in places, though. Some of the children say they want to be like FrostNova, and some of them say they want to be a hero like you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Time out, time out. Now that's a word I'm not happy with. How about you, Alina? What do you think?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: No two people are alike, in my eyes.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Figured you'd say something like that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Truth be told, I don't really know what FrostNova's life was like as a child. She's been brought up well. It was probably alright.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But don't let any child experience the things I did.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: You've been brought up well, too.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I don't want to talk about it.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...Talulah, none of us know the bitter things the world has in store for them, nor whether those things will be even more absurd than what we've already seen.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Well, that's depressing.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: It's also the reason I wanted to be a teacher.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: My 'teacher' wasn't anything like you, for sure.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...I get what you mean, now. You're saying maybe FrostNova also had, well...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Who knows. No two Infected live identical lives.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Well, to wrap up, I never slacked on practicing technique again after my dispute with FrostNova. Not just Arts, my swordsmanship too. Like hell she'll ever best me again in either.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I know you and her fought. What about after that?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It took until her anger abated before she told me she wasn't the one responsible.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Then that only leaves one person who could've been.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're right on the mark, yes. It wasn't too long after our scuffle finished...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...that out from another end of the city, came a...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...person.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Is remembering it that much effort?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I should say, that first impression was too shocking. I'm scrambling to find the words for you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The broad midday light spilled over his body, but couldn't melt away the black, black as tar.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I was in the middle of telling FrostNova about my project. I'd gotten up to where I was in contact with Infected in other cities.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I wanted to assemble the funds to construct or seek out a small-scale nomadic city, and invited them to join the project...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I saw his shadow. I couldn't keep speaking.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: What stopped you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not THAT confident in myself.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Not that confident? I've never seen you short of confidence before.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I mean, this was... Patriot.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: You couldn't talk him over.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I still haven't to this day.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You already know all the rest. After FrostNova and I had our 'friendly discussion,' our group successfully joined up with the guerrillas.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Good for us. All else aside, after hearing we could go with the guerrillas, plenty of our Infected here were happy beyond belief.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: These last two years have been better to us than before. You made a good choice. You're finally in the right, Talulah.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I mean... the way I see it, the guerrillas definitely didn't care about me or the other Infected fighters, they just... couldn't ignore the rest of the Infected, traveling with us.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Then that's even less reason to be down about it. You thought the same way, after all.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But it's been two years. The situation hasn't made any headway at all.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Think about it this way, Talulah. From what moment did you start feeling Patriot didn't approve of you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Over a year ago... not long after we joined up with the guerrillas. All the way up until now.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Not happening.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We don't even know how many more Infected are out on the tundra under Ursus's wretched rule. It's too early yet to be talking with the guerrillas about the Infected in the cities.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We're not intending to abandon the tundra's Infected. Why would I have brought them with me, otherwise?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Sooner or later will come the day we return. Our objective is to have Ursus's, no, the entire world's Infected come together...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We may be in differing places, but our lack of resignation to our circumstances is one and the same, indistinguishable.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: A friend of mine in a certain city calls that kind of behavior 'reunion.'

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: He calls on the Infected to come together, naming it the 'Reunion Movement,' revolving around one identical belief, protesting against Ursus's cruel rule over the Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And we should get the chance to protest the Ursus soldiers on the tundra about the exploitation in the mines, but I can't say it'd make them turn over a new leaf.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Talulah, forget the common people for a moment. Talk about the soldiers. The Ursus Army wouldn't let a single one of us go.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you want to go south to 'protest,' we could just save ourselves the trouble and find a division to kill us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Ursus is not a single-minded entity. This is our chance. What the Reunion Movement aims to do is pass on the belief, but I see even more opportunities in it. We have our own signal to send.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What signal?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: 'You are not alone.'

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You know better than I do that staying on the tundra is a life of attrition, eating away at our strength. We need to go beyond it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I don't decide this stuff.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're still not willing to decide it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If the price of leaving is death, then my life never had much use outside of taking down an Ursus soldier or two.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But what about the people around us?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Talulah, you haven't got brothers and sisters by your side. I'm not going to let mine throw away their lives.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But I think the other part's right.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Which part?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Telling the Infected they're not alone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We've spent too much time on one thing, here on the tundra.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Seeking friends.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But linking up with the city Infected?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Guess people from the big city really do like to dream a little bigger.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I don't need you mocking me yet, FrostNova.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm not mocking you. You're so strong. You've taken all of them a long, long way, just like us.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But it's a dream, going south, trust me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The guerrilla force grows, but we're Infected.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We don't have many years left... and your alliance would need plenty of years, at least...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And that's precisely why—

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dad?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Mr. Patriot?
Patriot sits down by the bonfire. Like Talulah simulated over and over in her mind, Patriot simply sits down, wordless, and gazes into the fire.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You're good. Keep going.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's precisely because we don't have many years left.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The south has fields of bumper crops, suitable temperatures, four seasons to tell apart, and all sorts of fresh food.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Resources, education, prospects...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And a future.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: —Future?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: FrostNova, there's every likelihood I know what you're thinking.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What I'm thinking is written on my face. I don't know anything you'd call a 'future.'

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We may not have much time left at all. There's only so many places it'd let us set foot.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But the Infected should have a future. For the future Infected, for those who come after us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: FrostNova... we'll find those Infected a home.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Somewhere Ursus and the Infected Patrol Unit won't disturb. Somewhere the Ursus armies can't surround.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And you know for sure, taking the Infected with us would get in the way of the guerrillas' operations. But we won't abandon them.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It'll be a seriously difficult path.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: At the very least, what hopes we bring about before we die can be left to others.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And, if we overthrow Ursus's present system over the Infected...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Everything will change.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We're thin on the ground.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you weren't an Infected, would you shake my hand?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We'd start from a handshake, in that case.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...What you're saying is probably...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Dad? Where are you going?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I've had enough.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Sir...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't mind it too much.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: He was probably just thinking it over.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: He's been thinking it over for ages, if so.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's been two years, and the only conversations we've ever had have been about team composition and following plans. He's never asked me once about anything to do with any project.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Talulah, no matter if he's ridiculing you or opposing you—ah, not that I think he's the type to really ridicule other people—you're still going to wait forever. Am I right, or not?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If we want to leave the tundra, we need the power of the guerrillas. I'll keep at it.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Because he's the hope of the tundra's Infected?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I thought you didn't say things like that. I mean, you never... you don't say things like that, right?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I just want to know what your thought process is like.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...I think—it's because he's the symbol the tundra's Infected unite behind.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: A symbol with no way of passing on to the next generation.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Get up! How long are you planning to stay there?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You gave me a chill, you goddamned white rabbit...!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I don't care how stick thin you are, don't tell me this cold front's too much for you!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You sure weren't saying that when you iced these Ursus weapons.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Brothers and sisters, withdraw! Let them follow! Draw out the mine guards!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Just hold on until the Shieldguards can support us! Don't lose hope!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: —Pace. Pick it up. Faster. The guerrillas are in place to get the mine guards double-teamed.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How do you figure—wait.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Those strange Originium ornaments. Did the guerrillas arrange those?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Those were set up for my father.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The Ursus army isn't pursuing us anymore. Seems like they're really not a fan of what those entail.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Wait, are... are these some kind of Sarkaz thing?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: His Sarkaz ceremony. These two are the best we could make with what we had on hand.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Patriot... is Patriot here?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You said it yourself. You were expecting our team to be surprise-attacked. And if we wanted to annihilate their whole company, of course we'd come up short if we only relied on our squad.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...They're already beginning to rout.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Have you ever seen my father in battle before, Talulah...?

steps.name: Local Ursus Troop
steps.text: The... him... It's him... Why did none of you s—say... say he was here?!

steps.name: Local Ursus Troop
steps.text: Retreat! Retreat! Just forget them, forget them!

steps.name: Local Ursus Troop
steps.text: Wait, hold on! He's coming from the rear? Then what's all this in front of us?

steps.name: Local Ursus Troop
steps.text: Hello? Hello? ! Say something! Say something!
Until those local troops let loose their violence upon him, the Sarkaz who towered over all others makes no move, nor does he make a sound.
Yet Talulah hears, laced through the north wind of the tundra, something not unlike cries. The shudders of the world itself, its wickedness cowering back, step after step, before the Wendigo.
Patriot stands fast, and casts toward the tundra a long halberd.
And in the gloom of a sky that knows only to devour all life, suddenly, a chasm is cut.
